Title: Azure private endpoint support for Azure Cosmos DB is now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure private endpoint for Azure Cosmos DB is a network interface that connects you privately and securely to a service powered by Azure Private Link. Private Endpoint uses a private IP address from your virtual network, effectively bringing the service into your virtual network. Get started today with Azure Cosmos DB and Azure Private Link.

Please note this preview is currently available only in the West US, West Central US, and North Central US regions, with more regions planned to be available soon.

Learn more
